entries.value: "Marketing channel MCP servers for the Marketer (#3146, epic #3145). A marketing channel IS an MCP server: its tools ARE the channel actions (send_email / post / schedule / get_metrics), assigned to the marketer stream via the normal MCP lifecycle. Ships the MOCK channel first — it RECORDS every call to a JSONL log instead of sending, so the whole plan→draft→approve→publish→metrics loop is testable end-to-end with ZERO real sends. Real adapters (Resend email, Bluesky) land later behind the same tool surface. Behind the shared mcp_rpc stdio core."
